rule: every predecessor row carried byte-for-byte in value (JSON deep copy) + one `constitutive_systems` block per key. system_shape.channel: silhouette | construction (the Reference section the basis sits in)
system_shape.presence_token: the governed observation whose value decides presence
system_shape.conventional: values that keep the system (RETAINED path)
system_shape.departure: values that replace the system (DISPLACED); a value in neither set → UNRESOLVED (fail closed)
system_shape.realization_parameter: the governed parameter whose value decides SUBORDINATED (null = token-presence system)
system_shape.re_proportioned: realization values that re-proportion the system (SUBORDINATED)
system_shape.basis: verbatim Reference lines (line number in the sealed Reference)
